Yongda agrees to buy 400 UBTECH U1 Pro robots for automotive retail

UBTECH and automotive dealership group Yongda signed a cooperation agreement on November 11. Yongda will buy 400 U1 Pro robots, with delivery planned before the end of 2026. Initial uses focus on product demonstrations, sales promotion and customer service.

The Robot Daily ↗11 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2

An order with planned deliveries

UBTECH and automotive dealership group Yongda signed a cooperation agreement on November 11. Yongda will buy 400 U1 Pro robots, with delivery planned before the end of 2026. Initial uses focus on product demonstrations, sales promotion and customer service.

Dealerships as a robotics channel

The partners plan a Shanghai robot experience center and potential displays inside Yongda outlets in eastern China. Cooperation covers requirements research, service design, sales, leasing and deployment support, using the automotive network for robot delivery and servicing.

Orders are not operating results

U1 Pro targets human interaction, distinct from the industrial Walker range. The agreement does not prove sales conversion or sustained service performance. Contract value was not disclosed, so multiplying a retail price by 400 should not be reported as the actual purchase value.
